description: US House Oversight Committee Ranking Member Robert Garcia (D-CA) and Representative Suhas Subramanyam (D-VA) wrote to Peter Mandelson requesting that he sit for a transcribed interview as part of the Committee's investigation into Jeffrey Epstein. The members cited evidence of Mandelson's "close ties to Jeffrey Epstein over the span of multiple years" and said he may hold information about Epstein's co-conspirators and enablers. The letter requested a response no later than February 27, 2026. As a foreign national resident outside the United States, Mandelson is not subject to the Committee's subpoena power, and the letter sought his voluntary cooperation.
headline: US House Oversight Committee Democrats Request Transcribed Interview with Peter Mandelson

info.description: House Oversight Democrats released a statement on February 19, 2026 stating that Mandelson had refused the interview request.
info.note: The office of Rep. Garcia wrote that Mandelson's lawyers declined the interview saying, "he is unable to appear due to the ongoing investigation by the Metropolitan Police".
